options.name: Progression Balancing
options.doc:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.
options.doc_html:
A system that can move progression earlier, to try and prevent the player from getting stuck and bored early.

A lower setting means more getting stuck. A higher setting means less getting stuck.

options.name: Accessibility
options.doc:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

**Full:** ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

**Minimal:** ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.
options.doc_html:
Set rules for reachability of your items/locations.

Full: ensure everything can be reached and acquired.

Minimal: ensure what is needed to reach your goal can be acquired.

options.name: Coin Blocks
options.doc: Add all coin blocks in the game to the location pool.

options.name: Difficult Logic
options.doc:
This adjusts the logic to be more difficult in a few areas,
allowing for the logic to account for players getting to certain areas in unintended ways.
Enable at your own risk, this is not an option made for beginners.

options.name: Skip Bowser's Castle
options.doc:
Skip straight from the Entrance Hall to Bowletta in Bowser's Castle.
All Bowser's Castle locations will be removed from the location pool.

options.name: Start With Extra Pipes
options.doc: Gives the player access to pipes 1, 3, 4, and 6 from the start.

options.name: Skip Minecart Minigame
options.doc:
Skip the minecart minigame that leads you through Hoohoo Mountain Base.
This will remove the 1 location in the minecart cave from the location pool.

options.name: Disable Surf Minigame
options.doc: Remove the surf minigame location from the location pool.

options.name: Remove Harhall's Pants
options.doc: This will remove the Harhall's Pants check from the pool.

options.name: harhalls_pants
options.doc: This Option has been Removed.

options.name: Item Block Visibility
options.doc:
This makes any hidden blocks in the game into regular item blocks and vice versa.
Disabled: Hidden blocks will remain invisible.
Hidden Visible: Hidden blocks will turn visible to the player.
Blocks Invisible: All item blocks will turn invisible. Hidden blocks will also remain invisible.

options.name: Chuckle Beans
options.doc:
Choose how you want chuckle bean digspots to be randomized.
An amount of chuckle beans will be removed from the item pool,
equal to the amount of locations removed by the setting that you choose.
None: No chuckle bean digspots will be added into the location pool.
Only Visible: Only chuckle bean digspots clearly marked with an X will be added into the location pool.
All: All chuckle bean digspots will be added into the location pool.

options.name: Goal
options.doc:
Vanilla: Complete jokes end with the required items and defeat Birdo to unlock Bowser's Castle.

Emblem Hunt: Find the required number of Beanstar Emblems to gain access to Bowser's Castle.

options.name: Emblems Required
options.doc:
Number of Beanstar Emblems to collect to unlock Bowser's Castle.

If Goal is not Emblem Hunt, this does nothing.

options.name: Emblems Available
options.doc:
Number of Beanstar Emblems that are in the pool.

If Goal is not Emblem Hunt, this does nothing.

options.name: Music Options
options.doc:
Choose if you want to randomize or disable music.
default: Music will be untouched.
randomize: Music will be randomized.
disable: All music will be disabled. No music will play throughout the entire game.

options.name: Randomize Sounds
options.doc: Randomizes every sound in the game, minus a select few that can softlock the game.

options.name: Randomize Enemies
options.doc:
Randomize all normal enemy encounters in the game.
If Bowser's castle skip is enabled, then enemies from Bowser's Castle will not be included.
Disabled: Enemies will not be randomized.
Vanilla Groups: Vanilla enemy groups will be shuffled with each other. Custom enemy groups will not be made.
Custom Groups: Custom enemy groups will be made and shuffled. Some enemy groups will only be semi-random,
including groups with flying enemies or pestnuts in them.

options.name: Randomize Bosses
options.doc:
Randomize all boss encounters in the game.
If Bowser's castle skip is enabled then bosses from Bowser's Castle will not be included.
Some bosses are not randomized due to flags, and story (such as the final boss).
Boss Only: Bosses will only be swapped with another boss.
Boss Normal: Bosses can be swapped with normal enemy encounters.

options.name: Randomize Battle Backgrounds
options.doc: This randomizes the background image in battles.

options.name: Scale Enemy Stats
options.doc:
This scales enemy HP, POW, DEF, and XP to vanilla values.
This setting is intended for use with the Enemy Randomizer and is Recommended to turn on.
If you are not using the Enemy Randomizer the effects will be minimal.

options.name: XP Multiplier
options.doc: This will multiply any XP you receive in battle by the chosen multiplier.

options.name: Tattle HP
options.doc: This will display the enemies' current and max health while in battle.

options.name: Mario's Color
options.doc: This changes the color of Mario's hat, as well as some key colors that are red including UI etc.

options.name: Luigi's Color
options.doc: This changes the color of Luigi's hat, as well as some key colors that are green including UI etc.

options.name: Mario's Pants Color
options.doc: This changes the color of Mario's trousers.

options.name: Luigi's Pants Color
options.doc: This changes the color of Luigi's trousers.

options.name: Local Items
options.doc: Forces these items to be in their native world.
options.doc_html: Forces these items to be in their native world.

options.name: Non-local Items
options.doc: Forces these items to be outside their native world.
options.doc_html: Forces these items to be outside their native world.

options.name: Start Inventory
options.doc: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}
options.doc_html: Start with the specified amount of these items. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

options.name: Start Inventory from Pool
options.doc:
Start with the specified amount of these items and don't place them in the world. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

The game decides what the replacement items will be.
options.doc_html:
Start with the specified amount of these items and don't place them in the world. Example: {Bomb: 1, Arrow: 3}

The game decides what the replacement items will be.

options.name: Start Hints
options.doc: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these item's locations prefilled into the !hint command.

options.name: Start Location Hints
options.doc: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the ``!hint`` command.
options.doc_html: Start with these locations and their item prefilled into the !hint command.

options.name: Excluded Locations
options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an important item.
options.doc_html: Prevent these locations from having an important item.

options.name: Priority Locations
options.doc: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.
options.doc_html: Prevent these locations from having an unimportant item.

options.name: Item Links
options.doc: Share part of your item pool with other players.
options.doc_html: Share part of your item pool with other players.
